jei.stellar_evolution.chem_overview.0: Coal → Coke Oven → Coke + Coal Tar + Coke Oven Gas
jei.stellar_evolution.chem_overview.2: Syngas → Reformer → Clean Syngas → Methanol / SNG / Synthetic Jet Fuel
jei.stellar_evolution.chem_overview.3: Coal Tar → Distillation Tower → Benzene / Phenol / Naphthalene / Bitumen
jei.stellar_evolution.chem_overview.4: Logs → Coke Oven → Charcoal + Wood Tar + Wood Vinegar
jei.stellar_evolution.chem_overview.5: Wood Vinegar → Distillation Tower → Acetic Acid / Methanol / Acetone
jei.stellar_evolution.chem_overview.6: Calcium Carbide → Acetylene → Vinyl Chloride → PVC; Acetylene + Acetic Acid → Vinyl Acetate
jei.stellar_evolution.chem_overview.7: Benzene + Nitric Acid → Nitrobenzene → Industrial Engine HIGH / Monopropellant
jei.stellar_evolution.chem_overview.8: Fuels: Burning Engine LOW; Industrial Engine MEDIUM/HIGH; Gas Turbine GAS/AERO; Rocket ROCKET
jei.stellar_evolution.chem_overview.9: Coal → Crusher → Coal Dust → Slurry Mixer → Coal Water Slurry → Synthesis Tower → Coal Liquefied Oil → Distillation Tower (late-game crude substitute)
jei.stellar_evolution.bedrock.0: Bedrock mining: the drill enters this mode when placed on bedrock and requires a network flow rate of at least 4,000 HP/t.
jei.stellar_evolution.bedrock.1: 1 Bedrock Ore → 1 Bedrock Powder; the acid-leach basic layer only yields iron / copper / lead / silicon / sulfur, no aluminum.
jei.stellar_evolution.bedrock.2: Aluminum dust is produced only by the high-performance S2 molten-salt separation (3 per batch), which needs self-heat solvent (Sr-90 + Pu-238), i.e. after fission reprocessing.
jei.stellar_evolution.bedrock.3: The bio-leach basic layer keeps boron / lithium / sodium / magnesium / graphite; titanium / rare earths still need high-performance isotope solvents.
